name: pi-footer-composer
description: Compose the pi footer as five labelled rows (环境 / 模型 / 资源 / 集成 / 配置). Each row is prefixed with a dim category label glued to its first cell; content cells within a row are joined by `│` and wrap under the label. 资源 merges token usage, context window, and any status whose key starts with `usage:`. 集成 / 配置 receive statuses prefixed accordingly; everything else falls into 配置 as a misc fallback.
